0x603F.text: Error code: the drive's last error, as in its EMCY messages; 0 means no error

0x6040.text: Controlword: commands the drive's state machine and the operation mode
0x6040.details: Common commands: 0x06 shutdown, 0x07 switch on, 0x0F enable operation, 0x80 fault reset (rising edge), 0x02 quick stop, 0x00 disable voltage.

0x6041.text: Statusword: the drive's state and operation mode status

0x605A.text: Quick stop option code: what the drive does on a quick stop

values.1: slow down on slow down ramp, then switch on disabled
values.2: slow down on quick stop ramp, then switch on disabled
values.3: slow down on the current limit, then switch on disabled
values.4: slow down on the voltage limit, then switch on disabled
values.5: slow down on slow down ramp and stay in quick stop
values.6: slow down on quick stop ramp and stay in quick stop
values.7: slow down on the current limit and stay in quick stop
values.8: slow down on the voltage limit and stay in quick stop

0x605B.text: Shutdown option code: what the drive does on the shutdown command

values.1: slow down on slow down ramp, then disable

0x605C.text: Disable operation option code: what the drive does on disable operation

values.1: slow down on slow down ramp, then disable

0x605D.text: Halt option code: what the drive does when the halt bit is set

values.1: slow down on slow down ramp
values.2: slow down on quick stop ramp
values.3: slow down on the current limit
values.4: slow down on the voltage limit

0x605E.text: Fault reaction option code: what the drive does on a fault

values.0: disable drive function, motor free to rotate
values.1: slow down on slow down ramp
values.2: slow down on quick stop ramp
values.3: slow down on the current limit
values.4: slow down on the voltage limit

0x6060.text: Modes of operation: the operation mode the master asks for

0x6061.text: Modes of operation display: the operation mode the drive is in

0x6062.text: Position demand value: the position the drive's profile generator asks for, in user units

0x6063.text: Position actual value in encoder increments

0x6064.text: Position actual value in user units

0x6065.text: Following error window: the largest allowed position error; 0xFFFFFFFF means off

0x6067.text: Position window: target reached is set when the position is this close to the target

0x606C.text: Velocity actual value in user units

0x6071.text: Target torque in thousandths of the rated torque

0x6072.text: Max torque in thousandths of the rated torque

0x6077.text: Torque actual value in thousandths of the rated torque

0x6078.text: Current actual value in thousandths of the rated current

0x607A.text: Target position in user units (profile position and cyclic sync position modes)

0x607C.text: Home offset: the position the home position gets after homing, in user units

0x607D.text: Software position limits in user units; both 0 means no limits

0x607E.text: Polarity: inverts position (bit 7) and velocity (bit 6) values

0x607F.text: Max profile velocity in user units

0x6081.text: Profile velocity: the travel speed of a profile position move, in user units

0x6085.text: Quick stop deceleration in user units

0x608F.text: Position encoder resolution: encoder increments per motor revolutions

0x6091.text: Gear ratio: motor revolutions per shaft revolutions

0x6092.text: Feed constant: feed per driving shaft revolutions

0x6098.text: Homing method: how the drive finds its home position; 3-14 and 19-30 are home switch variants, see the drive manual

values.1: negative limit switch and index pulse
values.2: positive limit switch and index pulse

0x6099:1.text: Speed while searching for the switch

0x6099:2.text: Speed while searching for the zero (index pulse)

0x60B8.text: Touch probe function: starts and configures position capture on the touch probe inputs

0x60B9.text: Touch probe status: whether positions were captured

0x60BA.text: Touch probe 1 position captured at the positive edge

0x60BB.text: Touch probe 1 position captured at the negative edge

0x60C2.text: Interpolation time period: the master's cycle for the interpolated and cyclic sync modes

0x60C2:2.text: Interpolation time index: the period is value x 10^index seconds

0x60F4.text: Following error actual value in user units

0x60FF.text: Target velocity in user units (profile velocity and cyclic sync velocity modes)
